localChanges: Late in a game, turns no longer stall for minutes when a computer player's unit wanders back and forth along a railroad, and saved games that had slowed down because of it load and play faster.

log: fix: one Contact between two players, not one for every move their units make side by side
fix: a unit stepping off its path stops after three steps a move, so one stepping back and forth along a railroad no longer keeps its moves and stalls its player's turn
fix: only steps that cost nothing count towards a wandering unit's limit, so one on roads keeps every step its moves pay for
